claims.statement: The Geological Survey Ireland report dates the oak-plank trackway to 148–147 BCE and says it was built in a single year.
Raftery’s excavation report dates Corlea 1 to 148 BCE using dendrochronological analysis.
The purpose of the Corlea trackway is uncertain; the geological report discusses a possible ritual use.
The Corlea map marker uses the excavation report’s site coordinates.
